column7: RECOVERY-MFA-RESET-1: the online MFA reset needs two different human global admins. The requester approving their own request is refused and audited as a denied mfa.reset_approved; the request stays pending and the target keeps every factor. Siblings: TestMFAReset_SameAdminTwiceRefused (a second request by the same admin), TestMFAReset_NonAdminOrMachineApproverRefused, TestMFAReset_TargetRulesRefused (machine identity, global admin, own account).
